description: The CMU Pronouncing Dictionary's corrected labels (nn/g2paudit.py; g2p.py applies them in every stage, before g2p-relabel.json, and the rule-labeled words derived from them follow) - words whose first pronunciation the cross-validated screening models confidently disagree with (fold models trained without the word: every model's phones differ, by a log-probability margin) and whose LibriTTS-R readers' audio confirms the alternative (the CTC phoneme recognizer's likelihood of each candidate on the aligned word with its neighbors: the votes' Wilson 95% lower bound above one half, from 3+ speakers) - or, where noted, the dictionary's own evidence (its derived forms). evidence: was (the dictionary's first), folds ([prediction, margin] per fold model), audio (candidates - the label first - votes and speakers per candidate, tokens, lower), date
